title: 국회의원청가및결석에관한규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:8:0:00008:part:1/1
full_text: Article 8 (Issuance of Request for Attendance) Where a Member has been absent from a plenary session or committee meeting for at least two consecutive days without good cause, the Speaker or the chairperson of the relevant committee shall issue a request for attendance.
